title: "Where's My Stuff - Inventory Rollup"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: cosmo
    orientation: columns
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(bigrquery)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)

# BigQuery connection
project_id <- "wmt-instockinventory-datamart"
billing_project <- "wmt-instockinventory-datamart"

# Authenticate (uses ADC on Posit Connect)
bq_auth(path = Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"))

con <- dbConnect(
  bigrquery::bigquery(),
  project = project_id,
  billing = billing_project
)

# Query the rollup data
query <- "
SELECT
  BUS_DT,
  MDS_FAM_ID,
  WALMART_NBR,
  OMNI_SEG_DESC AS SBU,
  OMNI_DIVISION,
  OMNI_DEPT_NBR,
  OMNI_DEPT_DESC,
  REPLEN_TYPE,
  DC_TYPE_DESC,
  UNIT_COST,
  STORE_OH_UNITS,
  IN_TRANSIT_UNITS,
  DC_OH_UNITS
FROM `wmt-instockinventory-datamart.WM_AD_HOC.WHERES_MY_STUFF_ROLLUP`
"

rollup_data <- dbGetQuery(con, query)

# Get unique values for filters
departments <- sort(unique(rollup_data$OMNI_DEPT_DESC))
sbus <- sort(unique(rollup_data$SBU))
divisions <- sort(unique(rollup_data$OMNI_DIVISION))
```

# Filters

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput(
  "sbu_filter",
  "SBU (Segment):",
  choices = c("All" = "", sbus),
  selected = "",
  multiple = TRUE
)

selectInput(
  "division_filter",
  "Division:",
  choices = c("All" = "", divisions),
  selected = "",
  multiple = TRUE
)

selectInput(
  "dept_filter",
  "Department:",
  choices = c("All" = "", departments),
  selected = "",
  multiple = TRUE
)

textInput(
  "item_filter",
  "Item (MDS_FAM_ID or WALMART_NBR):",
  value = ""
)

selectInput(
  "replen_filter",
  "Replen Type:",
  choices = c("All" = "", "REPLEN", "NON-REPLEN"),
  selected = ""
)

actionButton("refresh_btn", "Refresh Data", class = "btn-primary")

hr()

p(em(paste("Last refreshed:", Sys.time())))
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# Reactive filtered data
filtered_data <- reactive({
  data <- rollup_data

  # Apply SBU filter
  if (!is.null(input$sbu_filter) && length(input$sbu_filter) > 0 && input$sbu_filter[1] != "") {
    data <- data %>% filter(SBU %in% input$sbu_filter)
  }

  # Apply Division filter
  if (!is.null(input$division_filter) && length(input$division_filter) > 0 && input$division_filter[1] != "") {
    data <- data %>% filter(OMNI_DIVISION %in% input$division_filter)
  }

  # Apply Department filter
  if (!is.null(input$dept_filter) && length(input$dept_filter) > 0 && input$dept_filter[1] != "") {
    data <- data %>% filter(OMNI_DEPT_DESC %in% input$dept_filter)
  }

  # Apply Item filter
  if (!is.null(input$item_filter) && input$item_filter != "") {
    item_search <- input$item_filter
    data <- data %>%
      filter(
        grepl(item_search, as.character(MDS_FAM_ID), ignore.case = TRUE) |
        grepl(item_search, as.character(WALMART_NBR), ignore.case = TRUE)
      )
  }

  # Apply Replen filter
  if (!is.null(input$replen_filter) && input$replen_filter != "") {
    data <- data %>% filter(REPLEN_TYPE == input$replen_filter)
  }

  data
})

# Summary metrics
summary_metrics <- reactive({
  data <- filtered_data()

  list(
    total_items = n_distinct(data$MDS_FAM_ID),
    store_units = sum(data$STORE_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
    transit_units = sum(data$IN_TRANSIT_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
    dc_units = sum(data$DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_units = sum(data$STORE_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE) +
                  sum(data$IN_TRANSIT_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE) +
                  sum(data$DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
    store_cost = sum(data$STORE_OH_UNITS * data$UNIT_COST, na.rm = TRUE),
    transit_cost = sum(data$IN_TRANSIT_UNITS * data$UNIT_COST, na.rm = TRUE),
    dc_cost = sum(data$DC_OH_UNITS * data$UNIT_COST, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})
```

## Row {height=75%}

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Inventory by Network"

renderPlotly({
  metrics <- summary_metrics()

  df <- data.frame(
    Network = c("Store", "In-Transit", "DC"),
    Units = c(metrics$store_units, metrics$transit_units, metrics$dc_units)
  )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Network, -Units), y = Units, fill = Network)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Store" = "#28a745", "In-Transit" = "#ffc107", "DC" = "#17a2b8")) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Units") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggplotly(p)
})
```

```{r}
#| title: "Inventory by Division"

renderPlotly({
  data <- filtered_data() %>%
    group_by(OMNI_DIVISION) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Units = sum(STORE_OH_UNITS + IN_TRANSIT_UNITS + DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Units))

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = reorder(OMNI_DIVISION, Total_Units), y = Total_Units, fill = OMNI_DIVISION)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Total Units") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggplotly(p)
})
```

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Inventory by Replen Type"

renderPlotly({
  data <- filtered_data() %>%
    group_by(REPLEN_TYPE) %>%
    summarise(
      Store = sum(STORE_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
      Transit = sum(IN_TRANSIT_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
      DC = sum(DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Store, Transit, DC), names_to = "Network", values_to = "Units")

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = REPLEN_TYPE, y = Units, fill = Network)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Store" = "#28a745", "Transit" = "#ffc107", "DC" = "#17a2b8")) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Units") +
    theme_minimal()

  ggplotly(p)
})
```

# Detail View

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Item Detail Table"

renderDT({
  data <- filtered_data() %>%
    group_by(MDS_FAM_ID, WALMART_NBR, OMNI_DEPT_DESC, OMNI_DIVISION, REPLEN_TYPE) %>%
    summarise(
      STORE_OH = sum(STORE_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
      IN_TRANSIT = sum(IN_TRANSIT_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
      DC_OH = sum(DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
      TOTAL = sum(STORE_OH_UNITS + IN_TRANSIT_UNITS + DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
      UNIT_COST = mean(UNIT_COST, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(TOTAL))

  datatable(
    data,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      dom = 'Bfrtip',
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel')
    ),
    extensions = 'Buttons'
  ) %>%
    formatCurrency("UNIT_COST", currency = "$", digits = 2) %>%
    formatRound(c("STORE_OH", "IN_TRANSIT", "DC_OH", "TOTAL"), digits = 0, mark = ",")
})
```

# DC Breakdown

## Row {height=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "DC Inventory by Type"

renderPlotly({
  data <- filtered_data() %>%
    filter(!is.na(DC_TYPE_DESC)) %>%
    group_by(DC_TYPE_DESC) %>%
    summarise(
      DC_Units = sum(DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),

    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    labs(x = "", y = "DC Units") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggplotly(p)
})
```
